822-5261-7280.easyPrerequisites:
Roar of the Kha is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
822-5261-7280.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
822-5261-7280.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Donatello.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Roar of the Kha without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Roar of the Kha, untapping all creatures you control
Repeat from step 2.

2023-4770-6633-6723.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

5078-6650-7730-8171.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
5078-6650-7730-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

222-527-4247-4359.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-4247-4359.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

586-864-3125-4050-5477.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-4050-5477.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness, adding {1}{B}
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Insidious Roots.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Insidious Roots trigger, creating a creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1283-2440-4183-7895.notablePrerequisites: Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
1283-2440-4183-7895.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Little Bear with haste.
When the token Little Bear enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Little Bear trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Little Bear.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more lore counters on it

277-880-7885.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
277-880-7885.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Tiller Engine.
When the land enters the battlefield, Down in the Valley triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2034-6006-6970-7296-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

2921-4871-5220-7806.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
2921-4871-5220-7806.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1169-2411-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1169-2411-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Lathril, triggering Breath of Fury and Lathril.
Resolve the Lathril trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

2957-4508-7746.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
2957-4508-7746.description:
Activate Imagecrafter by tapping it, causing HYDRA Assault Robot to become a Pirate until end of turn.
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
HYDRA Assault Robot triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure token
When the Treasure enters, HYDRA Assault Robot triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-4772-7297.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1726-6798-6972.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Scrapyard Recombiner.
When Scrapyard Recombiner dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Scrapyard Recombiner's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Scrapyard Recombiner from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

2893-3875-4136-6763.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the basic land enters, Tireless Provisioner and Roaring Earth trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Roaring Earth trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

1887-4428-7009.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
1887-4428-7009.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Vorinclex.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

3446-3532-4842-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Chasm Skulker triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

5073-5220-6578-6900.description:
Activate Tinder Wall by sacrificing it.
When Tinder Wall dies, Mortuary and Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tinder Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Tinder Wall from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.
5073-5220-6578-6900.notes: Whether Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER or Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel is on the battlefield, the combo will function, either by using Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER's ability or the ability from Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel's emblem.

1168-1651-1770-4426-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1168-1651-1770-4426-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1168-1651-1770-4426-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Toggo triggers twice due to Elesh Norn, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

215-2246-2713-6726.description:
Cast Ruby either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {0} due to Bard Class plus commander tax, if applicable.
Activate Ruby by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {G}, returning Ruby from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
215-2246-2713-6726.notes: If Bard Class is level 3, you will also exile your library with the ability to play the exiled cards until end of turn.

2060-3054-5686-6701.easyPrerequisites: You have gained life this turn.
2060-3054-5686-6701.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire.
When Oathsworn Vampire is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
2060-3054-5686-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana value of the card in your graveyard.

280-719-1399-1606.description:
Activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Golgari Rot Farm.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

1657-4802.description:
Cast Murderous Redcap by paying {2}{B/R}{B/R}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer.
When Murderous Redcap enters the battlefield, it triggers, dealing an amount of damage to itself equal to its power.
Murderous Redcap dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Murderous Redcap's persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

3487-4770-5674.notablePrerequisites: You have at least {E} or enough mana to cast Whitemane Lion
3487-4770-5674.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {E} due to Primal Prayers, if able, or by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it and Aetherstorm Roc trigger.
Resolve the Aetherstorm Roc trigger, causing you to get {E}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Ghyyrson Starn.

428-2719-3090-5096.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal exactly 2 damage to an opponent.
428-2719-3090-5096.description:
Cast Harmless Offering by paying its mana cost, giving an opponent control of Protection of the Hekma.
Deal 2 damage to that opponent by any method, reduced to 1 due to Protection of the Hekma.
Ghyrson Starn and Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 5.

719-1636-4117-4302.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one other creature.
Visara the Dreadful does not have summoning sickness.
"Angel" chosen with Xenograft.
719-1636-4117-4302.description:
Activate Visara the Dreadful by tapping it, destroying another creature you control.
When the creature dies as an Angel due to Xenograft, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Xenograft, Bishop of Wings' first ability and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Bishop of Wings trigger, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

224-539-862-5094-5196.notablePrerequisites: Murasa Rootgrazer does not have summoning sickness.
224-539-862-5094-5196.description:
Activate Murasa Rootgrazer's second ability by tapping it, returning Crimson Kobolds to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
When Crimson Kobolds enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Murasa Rootgrazer.
Repeat.

451-2011.notablePrerequisites:
Hoard Hauler is a creature and does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block Hoard Hauler and controls at least five artifacts.
451-2011.description:
Declare Hoard Hauler and Najeela, if desired, as attackers, attacking an opponent who controls five or more artifacts.
If you declared Najeela as an attacker, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using Hoard Hauler.
Hoard Hauler triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
If the opponent controls eight or more artifacts, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

2749-3858.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is greater than or equal to twenty.
2749-3858.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers.
Holding priority, activate Wall of Blood by paying 1 life, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat step 2 until Wall of Blood's power is equal to nineteen.
Resolve the Mayael's Aria trigger, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain ten life, and win the game.

4200-4875.notablePrerequisites: Any creature type besides "Warrior" chosen with Conspiracy.
4200-4875.description:
Cast Icewind Stalwart by paying {3}{W}.
Icewind Stalwart enters the battlefield, blinking itself.
Repeat step 2.

1671-2026-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Voyaging Satyr does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Voyaging Satyr.
1671-2026-4222.description:
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {U}{G}.
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Simic Growth Chamber.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Voyaging Satyr.
Repeat any number of times.

413-1020-1414-4986.description:
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Myr Retriever.
Myr Retriever triggers, returning Lotus Petal from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Lotus Petal by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

538-1621-2781.description:
Cast Wispweaver Angel.
When it ETBs, target Felidar Guardian with its ETB and trigger Impact Tremors.
When Felidar Guardian ETBs, target Wispweaver Angel and trigger Impact Tremors.
Repeat for Infinite damage.
